description: This PHP file is part of the SuiteCRM system, specifically handling administration settings for the SugarFeed module, including configuration management and user interface rendering for enabling or disabling feed modules.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty templating engine class for rendering the UI parts related to SugarCRM administration settings.

methods.name: retrieveSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current settings for the admin bean.

methods.name: saveSetting
methods.description: Saves a specific setting value for a module.

methods.name: getAllFeedModules
methods.description: Returns a list of all modules that support SugarFeed.

methods.name: disableModuleFeed
methods.description: Disables the feed for a specific module.

methods.name: activateModuleFeed
methods.description: Activates feed for a specific module.

methods.name: flushBackendCache
methods.description: Clears the backend cache for feed data.
